newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY FORINT ENDS DOWN VS DLR TRACKING DLR/MARK.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY FORINT ENDS DOWN VS DLR TRACKING DLR/MARK.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed slightly easier against the dollar on Tuesday, tracking the dollar/mark's movements, dealers said.
"We moved together with the dollar/mark in quiet trading," said Andras Szanto of Europai Kereskedelmi Bank.
The forint ended at 170.10, down from 170.00/05 at noon.
The Hungarian currency closed some 12 pips off the National Bank of Hungary's resistance level (NBH bid), compared with some 10 pips just before the noon break.
Traders said that banking client orders, not speculative deals, determined Friday's trading.
They added that the forint would probably move closer to the NBH bid in the next few days as speculation was not seen weakening the Hungarian unit.
The dollar finished mixed in currency futures deals on the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE), while mark futures eased or remained steady.
Sterling finished stronger for all maturities as its price was corrected upwards following recent falls, the BCE said.
